headline: Eternals cliffhanger turns five
post:
Five years ago, Marvel left audiences with one of the most unsettling cliffhangers in the franchise. Arishem appeared above Earth and took Sersi, Kingo, and Phastos into space to face judgment after they stopped the Celestial Tiamut.

Now, with Avengers: Doomsday approaching, none of the immortal heroes have been announced for the upcoming crossover, leaving their cosmic fate completely unresolved. 🌌

headline: Adam Driver Confirms Star Wars Journey Is Over
post:
Adam Driver recently addressed his future in the Star Wars galaxy during an appearance on The Rich Eisen Show, confirming that he is completely done playing Kylo Ren. He shared that he and Steven Soderbergh worked on a potential Ben Solo project for a couple of years before Disney ultimately decided not to move forward with the film.

While discussing the cancellation, Driver expressed his appreciation for the unexpected support from Star Wars fans following the news. Further updates on the franchise will follow as new projects develop.

#AdamDriver #StarWars #KyloRen
original_title: Adam Driver Addresses His Star Wars Future After “Incredible” Fan Support for Ben Solo Movie

headline: Captain Marvel and Daredevil spark romance
post:
Hey everyone! Earth's Mightiest Heroes are back with some surprising new relationship drama according to Screen Rant. In The Avengers #1, Captain Marvel visits Josie's Bar in Hell's Kitchen following the events of Marvel's Armageddon. After losing most of her power and her ability to fly, Carol Danvers gets a visit from Daredevil. Matt Murdock shares some advice, and the two heroes nearly share a kiss before getting interrupted.

This unexpected pairing brings together a cosmic powerhouse and a street-level vigilante. However, the source notes that Matt's romantic track record is pretty shaky, and Carol is currently in a vulnerable mindset. Mixing personal struggles with superhero workplace drama creates a recipe for chaos that could threaten the team.

What do you think about this new comic pairing?

#CaptainMarvel #Daredevil #Avengers
original_title: Avengers' Worst Romance Of All Time Just Officially Began

headline: Cavill and Google team up for retro game
post:
Former Superman actor Henry Cavill has collaborated with Google to develop Mustache Protocol, a retro 16-bit video game inspired by the CGI used to remove his facial hair in 2017’s Justice League. The game pits players against rogue CGI artists trying to remove every mustache on Earth. Google announced that Cavill is building the game using the company’s new Googlebook laptop and AI-powered development tools, and they are documenting the process in a video series. 🪒

Google is also partnering with Movember to donate money for every play in November to support men’s health causes. Will you be trying out this hilarious new retro game? 

#HenryCavill #JusticeLeague #Gaming
original_title: Henry Cavill Made An Entire Video Game About His Justice League Mustache And You Can Play It Soon

headline: Wheel of Time Board Game Draws Star Wars Inspiration
post:
Hey everyone! We have some fascinating tabletop news for Robert Jordan’s sprawling fantasy universe today. According to Screen Rant, the upcoming project titled "War of the Dragon: The Wheel of Time" is drawing major inspiration from two giant franchises. 

Developed by Dire Wolf Digital, the new game successfully raised a staggering $1.1 million on Kickstarter. Creators Mike Mihealsick, Ryan Schoon, and Andy Clautice revealed in an interview that they wanted to capture an epic experience. They specifically noted that their first touch points for the design were "War of the Ring and Star Wars: Rebellion" to give players a rich sandbox where familiar moments might unfold differently.

It is certainly exciting to see this beloved literary saga expand into the tabletop space with such grand ambitions ahead of its release next year. Let us know your thoughts below! 🎲

#WheelOfTime #StarWars #BoardGames
original_title: Wheel Of Time Franchise's Official Return Inspired By Star Wars, Lord Of The Rings

headline: Spider-Man: Brand New Day supercharges Sony Q2
post:
Spider-Man: Brand New Day powered massive global box office success, helping drive Sony Pictures Entertainment operating income to $581 million for the fiscal second quarter. The studio's profits grew 525 percent from the same period a year before, with Q2 sales rising to $3.23 billion.

What are your thoughts on this huge financial milestone for the studio? 🕷️🎬
